build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay). Revision history: v1 (b3cd8b2) was a night storefront exterior with only a celeste accent in the text layer. v2 (ea3af4a) fixed that with a moody night-lit barbershop interior plus a Guatemalan flag as the one full-color element. v3 (55ba4fb): client found v2 'aburrido'/'oscuro', so backgrounds went full natural color with bright daylight and papel picado bunting. v4 (f7c00df): client asked to remove the decorations and show the flag 'como es' (accurately) and larger -- flag got the real national coat of arms (quetzal, scroll, crossed rifles and swords, laurel wreath) and became dominant, but was generated billowing at a diagonal angle. v5 (8c16dd4): client said 'no me gusta como pusiste la bandera haz que se note mas'; asked what specifically, client confirmed it was the angle -- wanted the flag straight-on and complete in frame, not diagonal/cropped. Backgrounds regenerated: flag mounted on a straight, perfectly vertical wooden pole, fabric hanging flat and facing the camera directly, fully visible within the frame. An intermediate regeneration pass that pushed the chair into the scrim zone is kept for reference at raw/bg-v5-bandera-recta-silla-tapada*.png. v6 (this revision): client asked (via text) for the piece to say 'hoy 15 de septiembre celebramos la libertad' and to reference that with something like a banda/desfile, or the signing of independence. Asked the client to choose between a parade-band scene vs. a historical 1821-signing scene vs. keeping the flag-on-pole -- client chose to keep the barbershop interior (chair, mirror, station) and add a school marching band parade (banda escolar: tambores, liras, uniformed students, several Guatemalan flags with the accurate coat of arms) visible through a large storefront window, in full natural daylight color -- not the historical/vintage signing option, staying consistent with design-system.md's 'modern, not vintage' imagery rule. Headline changed from 'Orgullosamente / Guatemaltecos' to 'Hoy celebramos / La libertad' (highlight: 'La libertad') per the client's exact wording; the date stays in the pill/caption so no digits needed in Lost in South (missing 0/2/8 glyphs). New backgrounds generated with scripts/kie_image_gen.mjs (feed 3:4/2K, story 9:16/2K) at raw/prompt-bg-v6-banda*.txt -> raw/bg-v6-banda*.png, promoted to assets/bg.png and assets/bg-story.png. design-system.md's duotone/gold-key-light photography rule remains deliberately set aside for this one commemorative piece (established in v3), same spirit as the color exceptions precedented in mundial-bandera-argentina/ and dia-partido-camiseta/. All prior background versions are kept for reference under raw/: bg-v1-exterior*.png, bg-v2-night-barbershop*.png, bg-v3-papel-picado*.png, bg-v4-bandera-angulada*.png, bg-v5-bandera-recta-silla-tapada*.png, bg-v6-banda*.png. Text/logo layer is real HTML+CSS (index.html / index-story.html), CSS unchanged since v2: celeste (#4997D0) pill, headline highlight word, and a thin celeste/bone/celeste flag-rule divider under the headline, echoing the flag's own colors -- only the background image and headline copy changed in v6. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). This is a purely commemorative post (no hours, no price, no booking CTA) -- distinct from the operational posts/instagram/horario-especial-15-septiembre/ post about special hours on the same date; do not merge or confuse the two.
headline: Hoy celebramos / La libertad
instagram_caption:
Hoy 15 de septiembre celebramos la libertad. Desde Nordic Barber Shop nos unimos al orgullo de un país que sale a la calle con tambores, liras y banderas. 🇬🇹

Feliz Día de la Independencia.
